name: 12B Sports
note: Main sponsor of the Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team for the 2026 season per its own announcement (12bsports.com, also distributed by GlobeNewswire on 30 May 2026). A self-described sports media platform launched in 2026; its site and legal pages name no legal entity, company, address or owner, so ownership could not be traced.
